headline: Nigerian Banks and Interswitch Push Tokenized Payment Adoption to Combat Fraud
summary: Executive leaders across Nigerian financial institutions and payment switch Interswitch are accelerating tokenized payment technology to lower transaction fraud exposure.
why: Interswitch is a major provider of digital payment processing and switching infrastructure in West Africa.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Tokenization enhances digital security, reducing financial loss from payment system fraud.
